name: "Smores" Caramel, Chocolate, Graham Cracker & Marshmallow Trifle Cups

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Duncan Hines Devil's Food cake mix; if using a different brand please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
TO MAKE THE CAKE: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat two 9-inch round cake pans with nonstick cooking spray. Cut parchment paper to fit the bottom of the pans and layer over top of the spray.
Place cake mix, eggs, water, and oil in a medium bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on medium for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (432 g) box devil's food cake mix
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Divide batter between the cake pans and spread out in an even layer. Place in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 19-23 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour.
When the cakes are cool, place graham crackers in a clean medium bowl and break into small pieces using a potato masher or wooden spoon. Set aside.
Remove one cake from the pan and cut into bite-sized pieces. (Reserve remaining cake for another use.)

In 12 glass or plastic cups, layer half each of the cake squares, crushed graham crackers, marshmallow creme, and caramel sauce. Repeat layering with remaining cake, crushed graham crackers, and marshmallow creme. Decorate the top of each cup with a final drizzle of caramel sauce. (If planning ahead, place cups in the refrigerator, and drizzle with caramel sauce just before serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (198 g) container marshmallow creme
¾ cup caramel sauce
